build.note: the modules commit (on modules main) and each module's wasm SHA-256; every step refuses to run on another build

X0.label: XP native: Jacchia-70 on the generic flux model, fixed by date

X3.label: NRLMSISE-00 times the open DCA (the E13 solve referenced to NRLMSISE-00)

srpPrior.note: AGOM fixed at 0.01 m2/kg (ruling 2); the lattice keeps it (ruling P8 (b))

fit.epoch: the arc's first state (the module's placement)
fit.thinRule: every round(300 / step)-th state on the product's own grid (G1); ISS at its native 240 s

O.cutoff: 00:00 UTC of D0 (ISS: E, the inputs of a 00:00 cutoff on E's UTC date)
O.rsga: the most recent RSGA issued at or before the cutoff (its header's Issued time), whatever date it carries; its Observed, Estimated and Predicted lines fill the days it covers; days beyond its last predicted day hold its last predicted F10.7 and Ap; no RSGA issued in the 72 h before the cutoff: the cutoff is excluded from O and counted
O.f107: days <= D0-2: DRAO observed (GFZ file); D0-1: the RSGA's Observed line when it is D0-1's, else its Predicted value; D0 on: Predicted, then held
O.ap: days <= D0-3: GFZ definitive Ap; later days: the RSGA's Observed, Estimated or Predicted value for that day, then held
O.center81: every row: the trailing 81-day mean of the observed F10.7 ending on the last day observed by the cutoff (D0-1; D0-2 when the RSGA in force predates D0-1's issue)
O.dca: the E13 solver's nowcast issued at the cutoff: arcs ending at least 6 h before it, 30 days back, the frozen settings, 48 h forecast decay

M.rows: observed F10.7 (DRAO, GFZ file) and GFZ definitive Ap through the horizon, the true centered 81-day mean
M.dca: the hindcast: the same solver issued at cutoff + 78 h (every arc through the horizon)

spaceWeather.license: GFZ Kp/ap/Ap/F10.7: CC BY 4.0, Matzka et al. (2021), doi:10.5880/Kp.0001; NOAA SWPC RSGA: US Government work

dca.license: derived aggregate of Planet Labs PBC ephemerides, CC BY-NC 4.0; Planet states and arcs stay local

P.name: drag-strong precise LEO (primary)
P.cutoffs: every day at 00:00 UTC of the period

S1.name: Sentinel-1 (secondary)
S1.cutoffs: every day at 00:00 UTC of the period

ISS.name: ISS from NASA trajectory files (secondary)
ISS.layout: E = file i's start + 24 h; the 24 h arc is file i's first 24 h; the long arc is the first 24 h of files i-2, i-1 and i (3 clean segments, about 5.4 d with gaps); truth is the newer files' first 24 h within (E, E + 72 h]
ISS.screening: NASA's burn marks in [arc start, E + 72 h] exclude the window

GN.name: GNSS MEO (control): B1's meo-gnss objects with ESA final truth in the period
GN.cutoffs: every day at 00:00 UTC of the period
GN.control: X1, X2 and X3 equal X0 to |ratio - 1| < 1e-6; a failure is a software defect: stop

LS.name: laser-ranged spheres (descriptive)
LS.source: B2 part 2: E6's variant R states at its cutoffs (XA's copy), the NSGF orbit chained as truth after T, the fit arc carried back from R's state by propagator/ffm

scoring.scorer: G1 lib/baselines.mjs rtnSeries (analysis/gp-error-model pair_statistics) in the truth's RTN axes; XP propagated at the truth epochs, TEME to the truth's axes by foundation/frames

statistics.statistic: the median paired ratio arm / reference over (object, cutoff)

primary.rule: merit demonstrated if the day-3 interval's upper bound is < 1 and the day-1 interval's upper bound is <= 1.05; otherwise no demonstrated merit

verdict.size: the median of the paired day-3 differences (km) with both arms' medians beside it, and 1 - the median ratio (%); practically meaningful only if the median gain is >= 10 % at day 3
verdict.components: the same rule for X1/X0, X2/X1 and X3/X2, for the 24 h arc, for condition M and for the secondary groups; no pooling across groups

density.probe: sdnap_atmosphere_probe: model 0 (X0), 1 (X1), 2 (X2), 3 (X3) on the condition's rows and $DCL
measures: (a) mean ln(rho_arm / rho_obs) over the 72 h arc
(b) its change from the arc mean to each prediction day

screeningSensitivity.method: analysis/maneuver-detection detect_maneuvers at its defaults on daily XP-native element sets fitted to the truth (the X0 24 h fit of each UTC day), with their propagator/sdn-ap trajectories; an event within [arc start, cutoff + 72 h] flags the window
screeningSensitivity.storm: a flagged window on a storm day: Ap >= 50 or any Kp >= 6 within [arc start, cutoff + 72 h]
